source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Once per turn, in the Shooting phase of your opponent's turn, when an enemy unit picks as a target a friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit other than this model's own that this model is within 6" of, 1 model of yours with this ability can respond:

- once that enemy unit has made all its attacks, that model shoots, as it would in your Shooting phase
- that enemy unit is the only unit those attacks can target, and it must be an eligible target

ability.trigger: an enemy unit picks a different friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit, with this model within 6" of it, as an attack target
ability.user: 1 model from your army with this ability

effect.after: that enemy unit has finished its attacks
effect.targetRestriction: only that enemy unit, if it is an eligible target
